import json
entries = json.loads(files)["entries"]
# Build a tree-like display grouped by directory
from collections import OrderedDict
dirs = OrderedDict()
for e in entries:
    p = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = p.rsplit("/", 1)
    folder = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else "."
    fname = parts[-1]
    dirs.setdefault(folder, []).append((fname, e["size_bytes"], e["is_dir"]))

lines = []
for folder, items in dirs.items():
    lines.append(f"\n📁 {folder}/")
    for name, size, is_dir in items:
        kind = "📂" if is_dir else "📄"
        lines.append(f"   {kind} {name}  ({size:,} bytes)")

summary = '\n'.join(lines)
print(f"Total files: {len(entries)}\n{summary}")
